_metadata.description: P2 requirements: expansion surfaces. Each is deliberately optional and none is a prerequisite for another tier. They are recorded so a later reader can tell a deferred decision from an omission.

requirements.description: The scenario may match settled charges against a rail's own statement and surface unmatched entries on both sides
requirements.title: Rail reconciliation

validation.notes: Planned test at `api/internal/reconcile/matcher_test.go`. Unmatched entries are surfaced on both sides rather than silently dropped, and a match never rewrites either source. Pairs with money-ledger OT-P2-001 so the two reconciliations agree on what unmatched means. [REQ:TRS-P2-001]

requirements.description: The scenario may emit and accept AP2-shaped signed mandates so it can transact with an AP2-speaking counterparty
requirements.title: AP2 mandate interoperability

validation.notes: Planned test at `api/internal/interop/ap2_test.go`. A native mandate round-trips through the AP2 shape without losing cap, scope or expiry, and an inbound AP2 mandate that widens scope on import is rejected. [REQ:TRS-P2-002]

requirements.description: The scenario may drive a card-shaped web checkout through browser-automation-studio under a mandate whose instrument cannot overspend if the flow is compromised
requirements.title: Browser checkout rail

validation.notes: Planned test at `api/internal/rail/checkout/adapter_test.go`. The instrument handed to a checkout flow is scoped to the mandate before the flow starts, so a compromised page cannot raise the amount. [REQ:TRS-P2-003]
Planned automation at `bas/cases/checkout/scoped-purchase.json`. A driven checkout completes against a local fixture merchant and the resulting charge matches the mandate exactly. [REQ:TRS-P2-003]

requirements.description: The scenario may read inbound prices from offer-desk rather than declaring them locally, joining what should earn to what a call costs
requirements.title: Price book read from offer-desk

validation.notes: Planned test at `api/internal/pricing/offerdesk_test.go`. Prices resolve from offer-desk when it is reachable and fall back to a locally declared price otherwise, with the source recorded on each receipt. The direction stays one-way; offer-desk gains no knowledge of this scenario. [REQ:TRS-P2-004]

requirements.description: The scenario may surface unusual spend patterns against a budget's own history as advisory signals that never block a charge on their own
requirements.title: Advisory spend anomaly signals

validation.notes: Planned test at `api/internal/signals/anomaly_test.go`. A signal changes no authorization outcome. The test asserts that an anomalous-but-in-policy charge still authorizes, which is what keeps the advisory boundary honest. [REQ:TRS-P2-005]

requirements.description: The scenario may let an operator save a recurring authorization shape as a named template so common grants do not get hand-built each time
requirements.title: Mandate templates

validation.notes: Planned test at `api/internal/mandate/template_test.go`. A template instantiates a mandate no broader than the template declares, and editing a template never alters mandates already issued from it. [REQ:TRS-P2-006]
